items.t: Head gasket failure and overheating (Northstar head bolts)
items.job: Replace head gaskets and repair head bolt threads
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $2,200–$3,300, but owners report $3,800–$5,900 once thread repair is included. Engine is usually removed.

items.t: Oil leak between the upper and lower crankcase halves
items.job: Reseal lower crankcase and oil pan
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,250–$1,770 for 1996–1999; a plain oil pan gasket on 2001–2002 is far less.

items.t: Stalls or won't restart from a failing crankshaft sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor(s)
items.note: Some engines have two crank sensors; one owner paid about $550 for both.

items.t: Fuel rail tubing can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a GM dealer

items.t: Coolant leaks from the water pump cover or thermostat housing
items.job: Reseal water pump cover/thermostat housing or replace water pump
items.note: RepairPal puts a water pump at about $710–$920 for 1996–1999.

items.t: Overheating that is hard to trace
items.job: Cooling system diagnosis and combustion leak test
items.note: Diagnosis only. If a head gasket is found, see that repair.

items.t: Knock or tick noise on a cold start
items.job: Diagnose engine noise

items.t: Delayed or harsh shift into reverse or drive
items.job: Transmission diagnosis, fluid service or control update
items.note: Price is for diagnosis and service; a rebuild costs far more.

items.t: Hard shifting that goes away after a restart
items.job: Transmission control software update

items.t: Flickering lights and swinging charging voltage
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Clunk or click in the steering when turning
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft

items.t: Power steering rack leaks or fails
items.job: Replace power steering rack with remanufactured unit
items.note: Add alignment. A pump alone runs about $720–$790 per RepairPal.

items.t: ABS unit can leak internally (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a GM dealer

items.t: Airbag inflator can break apart (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a GM dealer

items.t: Fuel can leak during refueling (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a GM dealer

items.t: Headlights work only some of the time
items.job: Replace headlight switch

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or swings
items.job: Replace fuel level sender (fuel pump module)
items.note: The sender is part of the pump module inside the tank, so the tank must be lowered.

items.t: Gauges or tachometer act erratically
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster
items.note: Mail-in rebuild services are common for discontinued clusters.

items.t: Keyless entry, trunk release and sunroof stop working
items.job: Replace driver's master window switch

items.t: Shake or vibration at highway speed
items.job: Road-force balance and tire inspection

items.t: Front-end clunk or rattle over bumps
items.job: Replace sway bar links
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $80–$120. Other worn parts cost more.

items.t: Rusted floor under the battery compartment
items.job: Repair floor pan rust under battery

items.t: Heated seat stops warming
items.job: Replace seat heater element

items.t: Paint cracking and peeling
items.job: Repaint affected panels
